Contributing to malariafwd

Source: .github/CONTRIBUTING.md

Thank you for your interest in malariafwd. It is a pre-release (0.1.0): its interface and its model may still change, so please get in touch before building on it.

Reporting a bug or asking a question

Open an issue and choose the template that fits. For a bug, please include:

  • the smallest example that shows it, ideally a run with few hosts and few days;
  • the output of malariafwd::check_setup(), which gives the versions of malariafwd, R, SLiM, reticulate, Python, tskit and numpy, and where it found SLiM and the model;
  • the output of sessionInfo();
  • for a run that did something unexpected, its params.tsv and cmdline.txt, which repeat it (with both in a directory dir, run_sim(load_params(dir), seed = s, outdir = tempfile()), where s is the run’s seed, ACTUAL_SEED in params.tsv), and its run.log if it failed.

Proposing a change

Please open an issue first, so that we can agree on the change before you spend time on it. Then, on a branch of your fork:

  • add tests for what you change in tests/testthat/, and run devtools::test() and devtools::check(cran = FALSE): with SLiM installed, the --as-cran check stops at the first example that runs it, on two FIFOs that processx keeps open so that SLiM stops if R dies;
  • document exported functions with roxygen, and run devtools::document();
  • add a line to NEWS.md;
  • for a change to what the model does, update MODEL_DESCRIPTION.md and give the reason in DECISIONS.md: change the entry the choice belongs to, or add one to its topic’s section with the next free number (entries keep their numbers, which the code and the docs cite);
  • after a change to the model file or to a default, make the example run again with Rscript data-raw/example_run.R (it needs SLiM 5.2 on the PATH), run the validation scripts with Rscript dev/validation-results.R, which rewrites inst/validation/RESULTS.md and section 13’s calibration table, and remake the documents’ figures and the numbers they quote with Rscript dev/make-doc-figures.R;
  • after a change to the parameter dictionary (R/param-dictionary.R) or the dictionary of the output columns (R/outputs.R), update the documentation’s tables with Rscript dev/update-doc-tables.R.

Code of conduct

Please note that the malariafwd project is released with a Contributor Code of Conduct. By contributing to this project, you agree to abide by its terms.
